project_scope.note: Texas persimmon is the installed local anchor. American persimmon has been deep-reviewed as the primary comparison but remains a range HOLD with Travis and Williamson locked; a third exact target-zone county is still required.

priority: flower position on current vs previous-season growth
study_strategy.warning: Fruit color is helpful when present, but leaf underside, shoot position of flowers, and fruit/ovary pubescence make the comparison robust.

quick_key.if: small 2–5 cm leaves with tomentose undersides + smooth pale peeling bark + pubescent black fruit
larger leaves + dark blocky mature bark + yellow-orange to reddish fruit
